papers.title: Maintenance Anesthetics and Postoperative Delirium in Older Adults Undergoing General Anesthesia: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis of Randomized Trials
papers.translated_title: 维持麻醉药物与老年患者全身麻醉术后谵妄：随机试验的系统评价与网络荟萃分析
papers.author: Miyake, T.
papers.summary: Introduction: Postoperative delirium (POD) is a frequent and serious complication in older surgical patients. The optimal maintenance anesthetic to prevent POD remains uncertain due to fragmented and inconsistent evidence. This systematic review and network meta-analysis will compare the effectiveness of remimazolam, propofol, sevoflurane, desflurane, isoflurane, xenon, and ciprofol, and establish an evidence-based ranking to guide clinical practice. Methods and Analysis: We will systematically search CENTRAL, Embase, MEDLINE, Web of Science, and major trial registries without language or date restrictions. Two reviewers will independently screen studies, extract data, and assess risk of bias with the ROBUST-RCT tool. Random-effects network meta-analyses will estimate pooled risk ratio (RR) for dichotomous outcomes and mean difference (MD) or standardized mean difference (SMD) for continuous outcomes. Treatment rankings will be summarized using the surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA) values or P scores. Certainty of evidence will be appraised with the Confidence in Network Meta-Analysis (CINeMA) framework. Ethics and dissemination Ethical approval is not required as only published data will be analyzed. Results will be submitted to a peer-reviewed journal. The protocol was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420251118351; submitted 11 August 2025). Keywords: Postoperative delirium; General anesthesia; Older adults; Network meta-analysis; Randomized controlled trials
papers.translated_summary: 引言：术后谵妄（POD）是老年手术患者常见且严重的并发症。由于现有证据零散且不一致，预防POD的最佳维持麻醉药物仍不确定。本系统评价与网络荟萃分析将比较瑞马唑仑、丙泊酚、七氟烷、地氟烷、异氟烷、氙气及环泊酚的疗效，并建立基于证据的排序以指导临床实践。方法与分析：我们将系统检索CENTRAL、Embase、MEDLINE、Web of Science及主要试验注册库，不设语言或日期限制。两名评审员将独立筛选研究、提取数据，并使用ROBUST-RCT工具评估偏倚风险。随机效应网络荟萃分析将估计二分类结局的合并风险比（RR）及连续结局的均数差（MD）或标准化均数差（SMD）。治疗排序将通过累积排序曲线下面积（SUCRA）值或P评分进行汇总。证据确定性将采用网络荟萃分析可信度（CINeMA）框架进行评估。伦理与传播：因仅分析已发表数据，无需伦理批准。结果将提交至同行评审期刊。本方案已在PROSPERO注册（CRD420251118351；提交于2025年8月11日）。关键词：术后谵妄；全身麻醉；老年人；网络荟萃分析；随机对照试验

papers.title: Health Status of Puerto Rican Youth in the Island: A Survey of Key Cardiometabolic and Mental Health Aspects
papers.translated_title: 波多黎各岛上青少年健康状况：关键心脏代谢与心理健康方面的调查
papers.author: Irizarry, M.
papers.summary: Background Puerto Rican young adults face elevated cardiometabolic, mental health, and healthcare access risks, yet this population remains understudied. We characterized cardiometabolic health, psychosocial well-being, and health-related behaviors among Puerto Rican young adults. Methods A cross-sectional survey conducted from 2022 to 2025 assessed self-reported cardiometabolic risk factors, mental health, loneliness, healthcare access and utilization, and attitudes toward health-promoting behaviors among Puerto Rican adults aged 21-35 years. We calculated prevalence estimates and used chi-square tests to examine differences by sex and age group. Results Of 2,783 participants (mean age 27.3; 72.7% female; 59.9% with >4 years of college), over 40% reported >6 days of poor mental health and 20.4% poor physical health in the past month. Most had health insurance (92.2%), yet over one-third faced financial barriers to care and lacked a primary care provider (PCP). Influenza vaccination was low (30.4%), while HPV vaccination (54.7%) and HIV testing (70.7%) were higher. Over half were overweight or obese (57.2%), 14.7% reported elevated blood glucose, and 10.9% hypertension. Females reported poorer mental health but greater preventive care engagement; males were more likely to lack a PCP and report hypertension and tobacco use. Younger adults reported worse mental health and higher loneliness. Conclusions Puerto Rican young adults carry a high burden of cardiometabolic risk, mental health challenges, and preventive care gaps. Further research should identify effective strategies to increase preventive care engagement and the adoption of healthy behaviors among this group, thereby reducing the chronic disease burden in later adulthood.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 波多黎各年轻成年人心血管代谢、心理健康及医疗可及性风险较高，但该人群研究不足。我们描述了波多黎各年轻成年人的心血管代谢健康、心理社会福祉及健康相关行为。方法 2022至2025年开展横断面调查，评估21-35岁波多黎各成年人自我报告的心血管代谢风险因素、心理健康、孤独感、医疗可及性与利用情况，以及健康促进行为态度。计算患病率估计值，采用卡方检验分析性别和年龄组差异。结果 在2783名参与者中（平均年龄27.3岁；72.7%为女性；59.9%接受过4年以上高等教育），超过40%报告过去一个月内心理健康状况不佳天数超过6天，20.4%报告身体健康状况不佳。多数人拥有医疗保险（92.2%），但超过三分之一面临医疗经济障碍且缺乏初级保健提供者（PCP）。流感疫苗接种率较低（30.4%），而HPV疫苗接种率（54.7%）和HIV检测率（70.7%）较高。超过半数超重或肥胖（57.2%），14.7%报告血糖升高，10.9%患有高血压。女性心理健康状况较差但预防保健参与度更高；男性更可能缺乏PCP，并报告高血压和烟草使用。年轻成年人心理健康状况更差且孤独感更高。结论 波多黎各年轻成年人心血管代谢风险、心理健康挑战及预防保健缺口负担沉重。需进一步研究确定有效策略，以提高该人群预防保健参与度和健康行为采纳率，从而降低成年后期慢性病负担。
